_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Mchezaji {player_id}, ukitwanga {num_rounds} mizunguko ya Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Umebeba ${pool} kusambaza kwenye mzunguko huu kati yako na Mchezaji {other_id}.

Mtoa Ofa:
  - Fanya ofa: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ikiwa imekubaliwa → Unapata $(pool - X), mchezaji mwingine anapata $X
  - Ikiwa imekataliwa → Wote wanapata $0
  - Mfano: [Offer: $3]  au  'Nafikiri hii ni haki. [Offer: $5]'

Mjibu:
  - Amua juu ya ofa kwa njia ya [Accept] au [Reject]
  - Mfano: 'Inaonekana kuwa inafaa. [Accept]'
            'Ni isiyofaa sana. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Mzunguko {round_number} unanza! ---
Mchezaji {proposer_id} ni mtoa ofa, Mchezaji {responder_id} ni mjibu.
round.accepted: Mchezaji {responder_id} amekubali! Mzunguko {round_number} unaongeza: Mchezaji {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mchezaji {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Jumla mpya: Mchezaji 0: ${total_0}, Mchezaji 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Mchezaji {responder_id} amekataa ofa! Mzunguko {round_number} unaongeza: Wachezaji wote +$0. Jumla huwa: Mchezaji 0: ${total_0}, Mchezaji 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Proposer must make an offer using the format [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Pesa michulo nyaka bed kwan makare.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Chiwo nyaka bed e kind $0 kod ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: No current offer to respond to.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder must either [Accept] or [Reject] the offer.

outcome.win: Mchezaji {winner} alishinda na ${winner_total} jumla dhidi ya Mchezaji {loser}'s ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Ng'ato ka ng'ato notieko gi ${total} duto.
